title: Stronger quiet penalty does not solve standing
summary: The 50-update quiet-priority pilot completed and strictly reloaded, but passes none of 48 quiet trials. Exact comparison and independent Fable review support a bounded normal-CAPS500 budget experiment. Reset-contaminated excursions remain labeled, and latest published weights are separate from the older actual video. The new source passed CPU and remote input checks and its two-update integration run has launched; the500-update run remains separate.
next: Finish source004 admission and compare the bounded500-update normal-CAPS run under unchanged quality gates.
